descriptions.run_id: Id of the continuous simulation run this row came from
descriptions.op_id: Operating point id — join to operating_points.csv
descriptions.split: train | val | test (assigned by operating point)
descriptions.label: Fault id, or "healthy"
descriptions.anomaly: 1 if any fault is present at any severity, else 0
descriptions.cylinder: 0-indexed affected cylinder, or -1 for engine-wide faults and healthy
descriptions.severity: Fault intensity 0–1 at the moment of sampling (0 for healthy)
descriptions.fault_category: Subsystem grouping of the fault, or "none"
descriptions.wear_level: Fraction of component life consumed at the start of the run
descriptions.rul_hours: Remaining useful life of the limiting component, engine-hours
descriptions.life_used_pct: Percent of life consumed on the limiting channel
